gates.description: Goal-card for the session written to artifacts/<session>/goal-card.yaml with an executable done_test

gates.name: 1.1 Motion purpose declared per animation: orientation, feedback
gates.description: Motion purpose declared per animation: orientation, feedback, continuity, or personality — decorative-only motion is cut
gates.command: artifacts/motion/<slug>/motion-spec.yaml: `animation, trigger, purpose, duration_token, easing_token` per entry; zero purpose: decorative

gates.name: 1.2 Duration and easing drawn from motion tokens only (e.g., dur
gates.description: Duration and easing drawn from motion tokens only (e.g., duration.fast/base/slow, easing.standard/emphasized)
gates.command: motion-spec.yaml references resolve against tokens/tokens.json motion tier; `node tokens/validate.mjs` exit 0

gates.name: 1.3 Choreography spec for multi-element sequences: stagger inter
gates.description: Choreography spec for multi-element sequences: stagger intervals, orchestration order, and overlap rules
gates.command: choreography section in motion-spec.yaml with per-sequence timeline table

gates.name: 2.1 Frame budget verified: animations hold 60fps (or declared ta
gates.description: Frame budget verified: animations hold 60fps (or declared target) on the reference device profile
gates.command: performance capture artifact (Chrome DevTools trace or equivalent) in artifacts/motion/<slug>/perf/ with dropped-frame count <= budget

gates.name: 2.2 Only compositor-friendly properties animated (transform/opac
gates.description: Only compositor-friendly properties animated (transform/opacity) or exceptions justified with paint-cost evidence
gates.command: `grep -rEn 'animation|transition' artifacts/motion/<slug>/ --include='*.css'` sweep: property list vs allowed set; exceptions documented

gates.name: 2.3 Reduced-motion variant implemented for every animation: @med
gates.description: Reduced-motion variant implemented for every animation: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) behavior specified and captured
gates.command: reduced-motion capture pair per animation (full vs reduced) in artifacts/motion/<slug>/; spec section names the fallback behavior

gates.name: 2.4 No vestibular triggers: no large parallax, auto-playing moti
gates.description: No vestibular triggers: no large parallax, auto-playing motion > 5s loop without pause control, or flash > 3/s
gates.command: vestibular checklist in motion-spec.yaml all-pass; any looping animation has a pause/stop control spec

gates.name: 3.1 Implementation mapping delivered: each animation mapped to c
gates.description: Implementation mapping delivered: each animation mapped to concrete implementation (CSS keyframes, GSAP timeline, or Lottie) with code-level parameters
gates.command: handoff table: animation -> implementation target + parameter dump (durations, easings, delays) matching token values

gates.name: 3.2 Before/after evidence captured: video or WebM of each animat
gates.description: Before/after evidence captured: video or WebM of each animation at 1x speed, plus a 0.25x slow-mo for review
gates.command: artifacts/motion/<slug>/captures/ contains 1x + 0.25x recordings per animation; filenames match motion-spec keys

gates.name: 3.3 Export assets meet spec where applicable: Lottie JSON valida
gates.description: Export assets meet spec where applicable: Lottie JSON validated, dimensions and frame rate declared
gates.command: Lottie files parse (`node -e "JSON.parse(...)"` exit 0) and carry declared w/h/fr; manifest lists them with sha256

preconditions.startup_phrase: Motion design mode: every animation is functional, timed by tokens, and safe under reduced-motion.
preconditions.bms_bias: A2-A3 preferred for choreography exploration; A1 for spec/perf verification; A4 only with approval

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times across sessions

success_conditions: All 10 capability gates passed with artifacts under artifacts/motion/<slug>/
Primary objective achieved: functional, token-timed, reduced-motion-safe motion system with implementation handoff
Performance capture proves frame budget on reference profile
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict, and next safe action stated
failure_states: halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4, 3.1: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.3, 2.2, 3.2, 3.3: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver

final_rule: No improvement entry, no session complete.
Outward action (publish, send, deploy) requires Gate-D approval — v0 is local-only.
Every motion-design-session session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
